summary: Jin Medical International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder meeting results. Holders of Class A and B ordinary shares approved two proposals: (1) increasing voting rights for Class B shares from 30 to 800 votes per share, and (2) authorizing the company to repurchase 3,769,057 Class A shares from Jolly Harmony Enterprises Limited, a controlling shareholder, at a price equal to the lowest 90-day VWAP. The repurchase is structural rather than a buyback tender; no outside advisors, premium, or deal mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine governance and capital structure filing, not a special situation event.
